scripts.text: Did you know? A long time ago there was a Magic Tournament in Geffen.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗？很久以前，吉芬举办过一场魔法大赛。

scripts.text: I've done so much research on the Tournament but haven't gotten too much information from research alone.
scripts.translation: 我对这场大赛做了很多研究，但光靠研究得到的信息并不多。

scripts.text: When I found out that this time gap can help with my research I couldn't resist the opportunity to continue the research.
scripts.translation: 得知这段时间差能帮助我的研究后，我实在无法抗拒继续调查的机会。

scripts.text: And now I've found an adventurer, in you, who can help me go back to the time that the Tournament took place.
scripts.translation: 现在我找到了你这样一位冒险者，可以帮我回到大赛举办的时代。

scripts.text: Please use the dimensional device and participate in the Magic Tournament for me.
scripts.translation: 请使用次元装置，替我参加魔法大赛。

scripts.text: Will you go and tell me about it?
scripts.translation: 你愿意去参加，然后回来告诉我吗？

scripts.translation: 就算你输了，我也想给你奖励～！

scripts.text: I hope to see you again.

scripts.text: I hope to see you again adventurer!

scripts.text: I am travelling with my good friend Chaos~!
scripts.translation: 我正和好朋友混沌一起旅行～！

scripts.text: I am not the one you should thank.

It's pretty rare to meet someone as righteous as {0}.
scripts.translation: 像{0}这样正直的人可不常见。

scripts.text: I'm on my way to see the Geffen Magic Tournament with Chaos.
scripts.translation: 我正和混沌一起去看吉芬魔法大赛。

scripts.text: Are you on your way there too, {0}?
Yes, you seem strong enough to be in the Tournament.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你看起来足够强，能参加大赛。

scripts.text: Just know that Fenrir plans on joining as well, so it won't be that easy.
scripts.translation: 不过，芬里厄也打算参赛，比赛可不会轻松。

scripts.text: This is my favorite magic buff scroll, so take it as a token of our appreciation.
scripts.translation: 这是我最喜欢的魔法增益卷轴，就送给你，聊表谢意。

scripts.text: It will be useful in the Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation: 参加魔法大赛时会派上用场。

scripts.text: Where are all these punks coming from anyways?
scripts.translation: 这些混混到底是从哪儿冒出来的？

scripts.text: It would have been much worse if {0} hadn't shown up.
scripts.translation: 要不是{0}及时出现，情况会糟糕得多。

scripts.text: You don't meet many people like {0} these days.
scripts.translation: 如今像{0}这样的人可不多见。

scripts.text: I was on the way to register for the Geffen Magic Tournament with Loki.
scripts.translation: 我正要和洛基一起去报名参加吉芬魔法大赛。

scripts.text: I have a feeling that you will register too {0}.

scripts.translation: 希望能在决赛中与你交手。

scripts.text: I have a spare magic buff scroll.
scripts.translation: 我有一张多余的魔法增益卷轴。

scripts.text: I will give it to you as a present.
I doubt that you can beat Fenrir at the Tournament.
scripts.translation: 我看你赢不了魔法大赛里的芬里厄。
她的战斗实力无人能及。

scripts.text: I hope to meet you in combat soon.
scripts.translation: 希望很快能在比赛中与你交手。

scripts.text: You're not a thief are you?
I don't know what to do about my zeny being stolen.
scripts.translation: 我不知道该怎么办，我的Zeny被偷走了。

scripts.text: It seems like all these thieves in Geffen are rich.
scripts.translation: 吉芬这些小偷看起来都很有钱。

scripts.text: They may be good at stealing but they're easy to steal from too.
scripts.translation: 他们虽然擅长偷东西，却也很容易被偷。

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about the shoplifters.
scripts.translation: 你把那些商店窃贼的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text: What am I going to do?
(I stole this envelope from one of those thug-looking guys)
scripts.translation: （我从一个看起来像恶棍的家伙那里偷了这个信封）

scripts.text: How much zeny was stolen from you?
Whoa! That's the same amount as what's in this envelope that I stole from that shoplifter.
scripts.translation: 哇！这和我从那个扒手身上偷来的信封里的金额一样。

scripts.text: Maybe this is what you are looking for?
scripts.translation: 你找的东西是不是这个？

scripts.text: Wait, this has to be my zeny!
Thank you very much for finding it!
scripts.translation: 非常感谢你帮我找回来！

scripts.text: I didn't say I was gonna give it back to you...
I will never forget your kindness~!
scripts.translation: 我永远不会忘记你的好意～！

scripts.text: I'm putting it in the bank right now!
scripts.translation: 我现在就把钱存进银行！

scripts.text: I guess... I did a good thing...?
scripts.translation: 我想...我是不是做了件好事...?

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about your stolen zeny.
scripts.translation: 你把自己的Zeny被偷的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text: So, are you asking me for more zeny?
scripts.translation: 所以，你还想向我要更多Zeny吗？

scripts.text: Zeny doesn't grow on trees you know!
I mean it is hers so...
I'll just consider it a donation to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation: 我就当是捐给吉芬魔法大赛了。

scripts.text: Well, I can't give away any Tournament participants any zeny...
scripts.translation: 不过，我可不能把Zeny送给魔法大赛的参赛者...

scripts.text: I stole this magic scroll from another thief, so don't worry about taking it.
scripts.translation: 这张魔法卷轴是我从另一个小偷那里偷来的，收下吧，不用担心。

scripts.text: I need to get to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation: 我得去参加吉芬魔法大赛。
